sloka: एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा वदति राघवः ।तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियाः ।। ७.९५.१० ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bhavatu bhadraṁ vo yathā vadati rāghavaḥ ।tathā kariṣyate sītā daivataṁ hi patiḥ striyāḥ ।। 7.95.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard their words and understood Rama's intention, the greatly effulgent sage Valmiki then spoke.
